paragraphs: PureTech Systems sells automation software that protects facilities, critical infrastructure, and borders. PureActiv, the product line, delivers automated detection, verification, alerting, and deterrence of safety and security threats. Auto-verification covers intrusion detections taken from video, radar, and fence sensors.

At airports, transportation authorities are the stated users of that perimeter protection. Rail is a second transit application, with detection and notification of any object of concern on the rail tracks. Military authorities and law enforcement are the stated users at military bases.

The customers page reports deployments in critical infrastructure, government facilities, and commercial buildings. Named customer types there include Nuclear Power Plants, a Foreign Ministry of Defense, a U.S. Defense Contractor, and U.S. Military Seaports.
